doc: keep the highest n dice of a pool; the `kh` suffix (`4d6kh3`)
name: kh

doc: keep the lowest n dice of a pool; the `kl` suffix (`2d20kl1`)
name: kl

doc: total a numeric pool into one die (a pool in a die position sums by itself)
name: sum

doc: n copies of a die, before summing (`pool(4, d6)` is `4d6`)
name: pool

doc: an equal-weight die from a list of faces, worst first
name: dl

doc: a weighted die from a `face: weight` dict, worst face first
name: dm

doc: fold a pool's rolled faces (highest first, with counts) into a die of states
name: evaluate
signatures: Pool[a] -> b -> (b -> a -> Num -> b) -> Die[b]

doc: name a die in the trace, like `[word]`
name: label

doc: roll again on the top face, at most n extra rolls; the `e` suffix
name: explode

doc: `explode`, short
name: e

doc: reroll any of the listed faces once, keeping the new face
name: reroll

doc: reroll one face once, keeping the new face; the `r` suffix (`4d6r1`)
name: r

doc: count the dice in a pool that meet a target
name: successes

doc: a list of n copies; dice in it roll independently
name: repeat

doc: join two lists
name: concat

doc: apply a function to each element
name: map

doc: keep the elements whose predicate is `:true`
name: filter

doc: thread an accumulator through a list
name: fold

doc: fold seeded by the first element (needs at least one)
name: reduce

doc: count a list's elements
name: len

doc: the smaller of two numbers or dice
name: min

doc: the larger of two numbers or dice
name: max

doc: a Num as an exact decimal
name: dec

doc: a Num or Dec as a float
name: float

doc: a Dec as a Num, truncating toward zero
name: num

doc: a Dec to the nearest Num, halves away from zero
name: round

doc: a Dec down to a Num
name: floor

doc: a Dec up to a Num
name: ceil

doc: absolute value of a Num or Dec
name: abs

doc: show each value as its own roll
name: roll

doc: reply with the die's exact probability chart
name: plot

doc: store a value under a name for every later message (a macro)
name: save
